Android Debug Bridge (adb), Windows build only — Android SDK Platform-Tools
  Copyright (C) The Android Open Source Project
  Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0
  Taken unmodified from the official scrcpy-win64-v3.3.1 bundle.

UxPlay — https://github.com/FDH2/UxPlay
  Licensed under the GNU General Public License v3.0
  Windows: shipped in resources/uxplay (unmodified, built from commit
  05b0275cb1b726592700e47a6e0307544b3d3a52; see resources/uxplay/SOURCE.txt and LICENSE-UxPlay.txt),
  together with GStreamer and its plugins (LGPL-2.1+) from MSYS2.
  macOS / Linux: installed separately by the user.
  It runs as a separate program started by MansoMirror.
